text: Planning a trip is exciting but needs effort. You must choose a destination, book tickets, and pack your bags. When you travel, you meet new cultures and try delicious local food. However, language barriers can be difficult. Sometimes you cannot understand people, so you use gestures or a translation app. Despite these challenges, travel creates wonderful memories. You learn about the world and yourself. Every journey teaches you something new, and you return home with stories to share with friends and family.
